Message:
docs(Mountain): Rewrite rustdoc comments to meet quality standards

Replace meta-instructional doc text ("This struct does X" → "X", "Represents Y" → "Y"), remove empty and blank doc-comment lines, and convert TODO-section module stubs into proper //! module documentation with structured lists.

Changes:
- `MountainEnvironment.rs`: Condensed struct-level doc to remove "Primary dependency injection container" preamble in favour of a direct description.
- `CocoonService/mod.rs`: Promoted stale "thin-wrapper dispatcher" ASCII comment to proper //! module doc with formatted item list; rewrote struct- and field-level docs to drop "This struct" / "Provides" meta-text.
- `RPC/mod.rs`: Expanded module doc to a formatted //! block.
- `rewrite_docs.py`, `fix_rustdocs.py`: Added automation scripts for ongoing rustdoc quality enforcement across the IPC and core modules.
